metadata.name: Receipt Printer
metadata.description: A thermal printer seen from above. Press the red PRINT button and a receipt rises smoothly out of the slot with a motor whir. The paper is one continuous strip: press PRINT mid-print to stop, press again to print another receipt joined on, and pull the strip to tear it off along a zigzag edge. Sound toggle included.
metadata.author: aakashmehra
